decisions.reason: As a homepage-promoted cloud messaging service that clearly extends the firm's core platform and stated move toward broader multichannel cloud adoption, management is likely to stay committed and view any weaker traction as temporary.

This product received its own page and a named customer reference, so the firm has visible commitment and evidence of adoption in a strategically relevant digital workflow area, making withdrawal unlikely.

Although less prominently presented, email and fax conversion fits the firm's established business with regulated, multichannel communications, so sunk development effort and customer process integration favor continuation.

Fax delivery optimization is less central and less visibly committed than the broader platform products, but because it still supports the firm's installed fax-related business and customer reliability promise, management would more likely retain than remove it.

Security is closely tied to the firm's value proposition in compliant enterprise messaging, so despite limited public prominence, prior investment and strategic fit make continued support the more likely choice.
